drivers.text: Management attributes growth to demand from traditional and AI workloads: record annualized gross bookings of $533M (up 35% YoY), double-digit monthly recurring revenue growth for a fourth quarter, and interconnection revenue up 10%.
Equinix accelerated capacity: nearly 40% more cabinets planned for delivery in 2026 than initially anticipated, consistent with FY2026 capex of $5 to $6 billion.
Operating income rose 27% YoY on underlying operating performance; net income also benefited from a non-recurring fee from the atNorth joint venture investment.
10-Q: new IBX builds are designed for power and cooling needs twice those of earlier IBX sites as AI drives per-cabinet power draw; supply chain constraints led Equinix to pre-commit purchases.
